inner_script:
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$name = 'SRC001-PREP-7a772f0'
$root = 'D:\LoaAlephPreparation\VM-PREP-SRC001-20260915-7a772f0'
$disk = "$root\vm\executor.vhdx"
$r = [ordered]@{
  scope = 'AUTHORIZED_FRESH_VM_PROVISIONING_ONLY'
  preparation_id = 'PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2'
  provisioning_id = 'VM-PREP-SRC001-20260915-7a772f0'
  restart_authority_commit = 'f8ec99faed3d816f2ba82b069d78e2179f409997'
  started_at_utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  operations = @()
}
try {
  $r.before_vms = @(Get-VM | Select-Object Id,Name,State,Path)
  $r.before_switches = @(Get-VMSwitch | Select-Object Id,Name,SwitchType,AllowManagementOS)
  if ($r.before_vms.Count -ne 0) { throw 'Unexpected VM appeared after the empty inventory gate; stop.' }
  $switch = Get-VMSwitch -Name 'Default Switch'
  if ($switch.Id.ToString() -ne 'c08cb7b8-9b3c-408e-8e30-5e16a3aeb444') { throw 'Default Switch identity mismatch.' }
  $r.before_vhd = Get-VHD -Path $disk | Select-Object Path,VhdFormat,VhdType,FileSize,Size,DiskIdentifier,ParentPath,Attached
  Resize-VHD -Path $disk -SizeBytes 16GB
  $r.operations += [ordered]@{operation='RESIZE_FRESH_VHDX_TO_16_GIB';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');result='PASS'}
  $vm = New-VM -Name $name -Generation 2 -MemoryStartupBytes 2GB -VHDPath $disk -Path "$root\vm" -SwitchName 'Default Switch'
  $r.vm_id = $vm.Id.ToString()
  $r.operations += [ordered]@{operation='CREATE_ONE_FRESH_VM';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');result='PASS';vm_id=$r.vm_id}
  Set-VMProcessor -VM $vm -Count 2
  Set-VMMemory -VM $vm -DynamicMemoryEnabled $false
  Set-VM -VM $vm -AutomaticStartAction Nothing -AutomaticStopAction ShutDown -CheckpointType Disabled -AutomaticCheckpointsEnabled $false -Notes 'PREP-SRC001-20260914-7ec21d2 / VM-PREP-SRC001-20260915-7a772f0. Preparation only. Attestation and replay prohibited.'
  Set-VMFirmware -VM $vm -EnableSecureBoot On -SecureBootTemplate MicrosoftUEFICertificateAuthority
  Set-VMFirmware -VM $vm -FirstBootDevice (Get-VMHardDiskDrive -VM $vm)
  Set-VMNetworkAdapter -VM $vm -MacAddressSpoofing Off -DhcpGuard On -RouterGuard On -AllowTeaming Off
  Get-VMIntegrationService -VM $vm | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'Heartbeat' -and $_.Name -ne 'Shutdown' } | Disable-VMIntegrationService
  Add-VMDvdDrive -VM $vm -Path "$root\images\provisioning-seed.iso"
  $r.operations += [ordered]@{operation='CONFIGURE_GUEST_BOUNDARY_AND_ATTACH_PRIVATE_SEED';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');result='PASS'}
  $r.vm_before_boot = Get-VM -Id $vm.Id | Select-Object Id,Name,State,Generation,Version,Path,ConfigurationLocation,SnapshotFileLocation,SmartPagingFilePath,ProcessorCount,MemoryStartup,DynamicMemoryEnabled,AutomaticStartAction,AutomaticStopAction,CheckpointType,AutomaticCheckpointsEnabled
  $r.firmware = Get-VMFirmware -VM $vm | Select-Object SecureBoot,SecureBootTemplate,BootOrder,ConsoleMode,PreferredNetworkBootProtocol
  $r.network = @(Get-VMNetworkAdapter -VM $vm | Select-Object Id,Name,MacAddress,DynamicMacAddressEnabled,SwitchId,SwitchName,MacAddressSpoofing,DhcpGuard,RouterGuard,AllowTeaming)
  $r.integration = @(Get-VMIntegrationService -VM $vm | Select-Object Id,Name,Enabled,PrimaryStatusDescription,SecondaryStatusDescription)
  $r.vhd_before_boot = Get-VHD -Path $disk | Select-Object Path,VhdFormat,VhdType,FileSize,Size,DiskIdentifier,ParentPath,Attached,LogicalSectorSize,PhysicalSectorSize
  $r.vhd_hash_before_boot = Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $disk | Select-Object Algorithm,Hash,Path
  Start-VM -VM $vm
  $r.operations += [ordered]@{operation='BOOT_FRESH_GUEST_FOR_PROVISIONING';utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');result='PASS'}
  $r.vm_after_boot = Get-VM -Id $vm.Id | Select-Object Id,Name,State,Status,Uptime
  $r.after_switches = @(Get-VMSwitch | Select-Object Id,Name,SwitchType,AllowManagementOS)
  $r.result = 'FRESH_VM_CREATED_AND_STARTED_FOR_PROVISIONING'
} catch {
  $r.result = 'BLOCKED_PREPARATION_VM_PROVISIONING'
  $r.error = $_.Exception.Message
  $r.error_id = $_.FullyQualifiedErrorId
  try { $r.vms_after_failure = @(Get-VM | Select-Object Id,Name,State,Path) } catch { $r.inventory_error = $_.Exception.Message }
}
$r.finished_at_utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\Public\src001-vm-creation-20260916.json' -Encoding UTF8
if ($r.result -eq 'BLOCKED_PREPARATION_VM_PROVISIONING') { exit 1 }
